spec: docs/writer-agent/WRITER-AGENT-SSOT.md §9.3 Refactor gate specification, item R1
purpose: Assign exactly one lifecycle class to every path under the Writer state root and every Writer log path. R1 classifies and audits only; it deletes, moves, truncates, rotates, and rewrites nothing. Pruning is R2.

classes.immutable-receipt: A publication receipt, a money row, a claim, opportunity evidence, a learning receipt, a state migration record, or a credential. MUST NOT be deleted, moved, or rewritten by any prune path.
classes.derived-artifact: Regenerable output: model stdout logs, generated images, candidate media, judge broker scratch, interrupted generation attempts.
classes.transient-log: launchd stdout/stderr and the wrapper-redirected run streams beside them.

default_reason: fail-safe: an unclassified or unknown path resolves to immutable-receipt (§9.3 As-Is/To-Be row 1). Enforced in scripts/state-lifecycle-audit.py, not as a comment.

basis_values.spec-immutable-enumerated: named immutable by §9.3 or the R1 work item
basis_values.spec-derived-enumerated: named derived by §9.3 or the R1 work item
basis_values.fail-safe-default: no derived or transient category applies; the fail-safe default assigned immutable-receipt

resolution_order: first matching entry in roots.<root>.path_rules (ordered, most specific first)
otherwise the roots.<root>.entries record for the path's first segment (inherited)
otherwise default_class (fail-safe), recorded as a fall-through by the audit
